sources.title: Mana Island (Fiji)
sources.excerpt: Mana Island belongs to the Mamanuca Islands, Fiji. It is Survivor Island, where the reality survival show is set and recorded. Mana was used as a tribe name in Survivor: Game Changers. The islands Malolo and Qalito are to the south and Matamanoa and Tavua are located north of the island.
